name: Gemma 4 31B (dense, multimodal)
context_scaling: per-layer-type rope (full_attention theta 1e6 proportional / sliding_attention theta 1e4 default)
attention_variant: GQA + sliding-window/global hybrid with separate global head geometry (global_head_dim 512, num_global_key_value_heads 4)
notes: PARAMS: 31.27B is the safetensors weight count including the vision tower. Dense (num_experts is null). Google's doc puts the BF16 footprint at 69.9 GB, SFP8 at 34.9 GB, Q4_0 at 17.5 GB. KV left null for the same reason as the 26B A4B: sliding layers use head_dim 256 with 16 KV heads while global layers use global_head_dim 512 with 4 global KV heads (4*512 = 2048 vs 16*256 = 4096 elements), across 10 global layers of 60. Two geometries, one stack, no single config field to derive from. This is the direct dense-vs-MoE counterpart to the 26B A4B: roughly the same weight count (31.3B vs 25.8B) but 31.3B active per token versus 4B, against the same 256k context and the same hybrid-attention family.
